Calendar

Source: R/tier2-calendar.R
shad_calendar.Rd

A shadcn calendar. The month grid is rendered client-side from the seed attributes. input$<inputId> is a Date (single) or length-2 Date (range), via the shadshiny.date input handler.

Usage

shad_calendar(
  inputId,
  value = NULL,
  mode = c("single", "range"),
  min = NULL,
  max = NULL,
  month = NULL,
  caption_layout = c("label", "dropdown", "dropdown-months", "dropdown-years"),
  year_range = NULL,
  week_starts_on = 0,
  disabled = FALSE,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

inputId

Input id.

value

Initial selection: a Date/character (single) or length-2 Date/character (range).

mode

"single" (default) or "range".

min, max

Selectable bounds (inclusive), Date/character.

month

Initially displayed month (Date or "YYYY-MM"). Sets the month the grid opens on without selecting anything.

caption_layout

Header style: "label" (default, month and year as text), "dropdown" (both as selects), "dropdown-months" or "dropdown-years". Use a dropdown when the user has to travel years, such as a date of birth.

year_range

Length-2 numeric bounding the year dropdown, e.g. c(1900, 2025). Defaults to the years of min/max when given, otherwise 100 years back and 10 forward.

week_starts_on

0 (Sunday, default) or 1 (Monday).

disabled

If TRUE, disables the control.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes on the calendar root.

Value

A calendar tag.

See also

Other shadshiny tier-2 components: shad_checkbox(), shad_combobox(), shad_date_picker(), shad_date_presets(), shad_form_field(), shad_input(), shad_input_group(), shad_input_otp(), shad_native_select(), shad_radio_group(), shad_select(), shad_slider(), shad_switch(), shad_textarea(), shad_toggle(), shad_toggle_group()

Examples

shad_calendar("day", value = Sys.Date())
#> <div class="shad-calendar" data-shad="calendar" id="day" data-mode="single" data-value="2026-10-30" data-week-start="0"></div>
shad_calendar("range", mode = "range", week_starts_on = 1)
#> <div class="shad-calendar" data-shad="calendar" id="range" data-mode="range" data-week-start="1"></div>
shad_calendar("dob", caption_layout = "dropdown", year_range = c(1900, 2025))
#> <div class="shad-calendar" data-shad="calendar" id="dob" data-mode="single" data-week-start="0" data-caption-layout="dropdown" data-from-year="1900" data-to-year="2025"></div>
